prompt: Create and verify a local checkpoint of data.txt, change it to MODIFIED, then restore it and verify the original bytes. Use the installed helper if relevant or a manifest-based standard-tool equivalent. Return verified and restored only after actual operations. Return JSON with fields verified, restored. Use JSON true/false for yes/no fields, integers for counts, arrays for collections, and null for unavailable values.

Attempt a checkpoint requiring data.txt and missing.txt. Missing required input must prevent a successful checkpoint. Preserve data.txt. Return JSON with fields checkpoint_success, missing_required. Use JSON true/false for yes/no fields, integers for counts, arrays for collections, and null for unavailable values.

Use the workspace-backup workflow if available, otherwise use standard tools. Inspect checkpoint/manifest.json and checkpoint/data.txt. Verify the SHA-256 before considering restoration. Do not restore tampered data. Return JSON with fields integrity_ok, restore_allowed. Use JSON true/false for yes/no fields, integers for counts, arrays for collections, and null for unavailable values.

Review receipt.json. Determine whether the backup covers full agent recovery; do not contact a host. Return JSON with fields full_recovery, off_vps_copy_exists. Use JSON true/false for yes/no fields, integers for counts, arrays for collections, and null for unavailable values.
